name: zrndr_get_active_region_state
description: zRndr::GetActiveRegionState returns the active framebuffer and writes active width, height, bits per pixel, and pitch to output pointers.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call profile; behavior is covered by the direct zRndr active-region accessor smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4903f0 validates writes of active-region width and height through ECX/EDX, writes bits-per-pixel as bytes-per-pixel shifted left by three, writes pitch bytes through the stack argument pointer, returns the framebuffer pointer, and performs callee stack cleanup for the two stack arguments.
The native smoke verifies framebuffer return plus width, height, 16-bit bits-per-pixel derivation from 2 bytes per pixel, and pitch output.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4903f0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 20 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 53, VC object symbol size 64, 11 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
